items.information: The competition will be held in multiple locations, across Anglo America. Please pay attention to the **time zone** of your location! Locations may be added until **Monday, February 13th 11:59 EST**, so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) in Anglo America.

items.information: ## On the spot registration has opened for the following locations: * Davis, CA * Santa Clara, CA * San Diego, CA * Reno, NV * Kailua, HI If you would like to participate at one of these locations, please [contact us by using the link here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=WCCWesternFMCChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) --- - This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. **We do not recommend new competitors attend this competition.** - This competition will take place at different venues across California, Nevada, and Hawaii. Please reach out to local delegates to reach out to us about hosting a location. - Check out the [Locations Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCWesternFMCChampionship2024#52263-locations) for more details. This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
